test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Bonalu is a Hindu festival celebrated to worship Goddess Mahakali in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bonalu is a festival celebrated in the Telangana state during July or August (or Ashada masam). Hence option 1 is correct.**
 
• Bonalu means a meal which is offered to the goddess.
 
• The devotees perform pooja for the goddess Mahakali or Yellamma (called in the state) during the first and last day of the festival.
 
• **Other festivals celebrated in Telangana are Dussehra or Navratri, Muhharam, Sammakka Saarakka Jathara, Ganesh Chaturthi etc. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
